sources.title: GitHub - apirrone/microduck_runtime
sources.snippet: The --maploc flag enables 2D ToF-based mapping, MCL localization, and A* path planning, provided by the microduck_maploc-rs crate. It runs autonomously: the duck builds an occupancy grid as it moves, localizes against it, and (when given a goal) plans + executes a path.
